summary: A diagnostic Hair Lab panel composed from existing headings, toggles, value controls and in-place progress.
binding: The explicitly selected hair-lab session and its independent groom document.
x-controls: Hair Lab toggle, Length, Waves and Volume, with Ready or in-place shaping/settling feedback; no gestures in M1, no new component-library controls.
x-refusal: Generation failure restores normal hair and offers Try again through the existing request; no path prompts or technical error labels.
